tagline: Tandon School of Engineering · New York University
description: Cities extend their influence far beyond their physical boundaries, affecting ecosystems, climate, and societies worldwide. At the Urban Planet Lab, we study the dynamics and impacts of urbanization at multiple scales—from local neighborhoods to global systems—to better understand and address the complex challenges of our increasingly urbanized world.

cards.title: Cities as Complex Systems
cards.description: Cities and extreme weather are two complex dynamical systems that interact across scales, and urban heat is one of the many emergent outcomes. We bring fractals, scaling laws, and network thinking to understand how cities self-organize.

cards.title: Multi-scale Urban Sensing
cards.description: How the built environment and the local climate dynamically interact with one another. We study both persistent urban heat and periodic heatwaves and design solutions to build resilience against them.

cards.title: Climate-conscious Urban Design
cards.description: Using ground-based, airborne, and spaceborne thermal remote sensing, we characterize the built environment and the microclimate at high-resolution spatial scale to turn observation into insight.
